title: Prompting Voice Agents in ElevenLabs: The ElevenAgents Prompting Guide
desc:
ElevenLabs tutorial: Prompting Voice Agents in ElevenLabs: The ElevenAgents Prompting Guide.

The system prompt is the personality and policy blueprint of a voice agent. This episode walks through the official ElevenAgents prompting guide: clean sections, concise instructions, emphasis, text normalization, formats for tool inputs, when and how to use tools, orchestrator and specialist agents, choosing an LLM, Guardrails 2.0 with streaming and blocking modes, and how to iterate safely.

This episode is a documented walkthrough built from the official ElevenLabs documentation (links below). It does not include a live product recording.
